Default code language annotation on blocks without lang attribute

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"code_language\":\"python\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<pre><code>def hello(): pass</code></pre>", options)
```
